decisions.reason: As a core capital-good product in a mature machinery portfolio, a two-component resin injection unit would usually be kept unless sales were clearly weak.
This second resin injection unit is likely a variant in the same core application area, so despite some overlap the firm would usually retain it if it serves a distinct customer segment.
An automatic airless spray gun fits well with an industrial coating-equipment supplier's system business and is therefore more likely to remain on the market.
A manual airless spray gun is somewhat more exposed to range simplification and price competition, but it still complements the firm's installed base and sales offering.
An air-assisted airless spray gun is a specialized but relevant extension of the coating portfolio, so a medium German machinery firm would typically continue offering it.
Because the data logger lost its dedicated product presentation already by 2019, it looks less strategically important and more likely to be discontinued or absorbed into other solutions.
